description: This Java class defines a Data Access Object (DAO) for OTA Package Information, implementing methods to retrieve, save, and query OTA package data from a SQL database using Spring Data JPA.

classes.name: JpaOtaPackageInfoDao
classes.description: A DAO class for OTA Package Info, providing database operations for OTA package data.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for database operations.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves an OTA package info by its UUID within a tenant.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an OTA package info entity to the database.

methods.name: findOtaPackageInfoByTenantId
methods.description: Finds OTA package info entries for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findOtaPackageInfoByTenantIdAndDeviceProfileIdAndTypeAndHasData
methods.description: Finds OTA package info entries filtered by tenant, device profile, type, and data presence with pagination.

methods.name: isOtaPackageUsed
methods.description: Checks if a specific OTA package is used by any device profile.
